description:
Execution boundary: planning approved; this issue does not authorize commits, pushes, merges, upstream publication, GitHub comments, live WhatsApp access, or real messages. Revalidate current source/Git state before implementation. Preserve unrelated work, including the already-edited docs/architecture.md. Track this work in the ZAQ Beadwork store even when files belong to the sibling package; do not initialize another store.
Read AGENTS.md in the affected repository. For ZAQ read docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the domain policies listed below. Read module documentation before editing. Source navigation uses Serena with bounded fallback if unavailable. Record test results honestly; plan approval is not completed-feature UX approval. Follow repository validation owners; no assertion weakening or unrelated refactors. Existing test changes outside the specifically approved contracts need human approval.

Required domain policies: docs/services/channels.md; docs/services/engine.md; docs/services/system-config.md; docs/action-reuse.md.

Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
ZAQ Channels owners: lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex, communication_bridge.ex and api.ex only as needed for existing connector lifecycle routing. Preserve current super-admin/confidential authorization of logout/prepare-disable. Within the protected lifecycle introduced in zaq-e5z.6, a running exact selected listener uses existing Adapter.logout; ONLY lookup {:error, :not_running} selects offline cleanup. Other lookup/transport/storage errors must remain errors; no broad catch-and-ignore.
Resolve the existing credential binding from selected runtime config using profile_binding/1 or an equivalent existing validated path; never :bind just to clean up and never reconstruct WhatsApp namespace/profile hashing in ZAQ. Discover cleanup_connection/2 via Code.ensure_loaded/function_exported? on the configured adapter. Invoke it directly as the explicitly approved package extension, supplying trusted sink/connection options. Do not add a jido_chat callback or call Jido.Chat.WhatsApp.Storage/Amarula modules from ZAQ. Missing capability returns unsupported when cleanup is required; preserve existing adapters' optional no-logout behavior where already supported.
Shared host Storage.Request remains the sole credential callback; revalidate provider/config/binding on every request and keep bytes out of public results. Do not expose cleanup as a public browser credential operation. Preserve exact scope, no auto-provision/reactivation, sanitized failures and ordinary stop retention. This issue provides the primitive; final lifecycle correctness is not complete until zaq-e5z.6 proves exclusion through commit/stop.

Tests to add before implementation:
Add focused Channels tests before edits in test/zaq/channels/linked_device/runtime_contracts_test.exs and connector_disable_test.exs: running listener still delegates existing logout; missing listener calls only configured cleanup extension with expected existing binding; wrong provider/binding, missing/non-admin actor, invalid trusted context rejected; unsupported capability, unexpected runtime shape and other lookup failure propagate; callback failure does not report success; no bind/provision operation; sibling unaffected. Real role/storage integration in zaq-e5z.6 is also mandatory.

Branches/paths validated:
Running/absent/failed lookup, supported/unsupported extension, missing/corrupt binding, rejected identity, successful/failed/uncertain cleanup, ordinary shutdown.

Mocking plan:
Use installed adapter with real Engine document callbacks where possible; stub only package/transport edge for targeted delegation/error assertions. No global module replacement without isolated process/VM.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Update bridge specs/docs and docs/services/channels.md to remove claim that a missing listener always prevents disable. Explain configured-adapter extension and authority. System-config owner docs updated only if storage contract wording changes.

Action reuse assessment:
Decision: extend existing Channels connector logout/prepare-disable path. Candidates CommunicationBridge, JidoChatBridge.logout_listener, profile_binding, configured adapter.logout and new package cleanup_connection. Adapter owns provider storage; Engine/Connect remains encrypted host owner. New Action is unnecessary because existing confidential lifecycle events already own this operation. Runtime-only primitive, no agent/workflow/BO direct storage consumer. Input selected resolved config + authorized actor -> :ok or sanitized error; idempotence delegated to adapter. Test both consumers use this one path.

comments.text: Installed published c6edbf6 via mix deps.update (only intended lock entry). Missing listener selects configured adapter.cleanup_connection with existing binding and trusted sink; missing binding never provisions, other lookup errors remain explicit. Real failing-activation fixtures reproduced disable/archive errors then passed; 11 focused integration/Action tests and mix q pass. No concrete WhatsApp storage implementation called from ZAQ. Docs updated for actual Git pin. Full-lifetime exclusion remains next issue.
